# Experiment Overview

This file describes the experiments in `scoring/scores.json`. Each experiment name corresponds one-to-one to an entry in the scores file.

---

## watermark_detection_mistral

**Goal:** Establish whether GaussMark can detect watermarked text generated by Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, at controlled false-positive rates.

**Setup:**
- Model: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (HuggingFace `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3`)
- Prompts: 100 prompts from C4 realnewslike dataset (truncated to ≤200 tokens each)
- Generation: 200 tokens per prompt, temperature=1.0, top-p=0.9
- Detection: significance-thresholded p-values at 5% and 1% false-positive thresholds, plus median p-value and AUC
- Quality constraint: C4 cross-entropy is reported as a ratio/delta between the marked and original model on the same prompt source

**Methods evaluated:**
1. `gaussmark_200_tokens` — primary marked-generation result, 100 prompts by default
2. `unwatermarked` — no watermark applied, 100 samples (for FPR baseline)

**What success looks like:**
- Watermarked text has detection rate significantly above the unwatermarked baseline rate
- AUC > 0.5 (above random)
- Unwatermarked text has FPR close to the target threshold (~5% at p<0.05, ~1% at p<0.01)
